profile.headline: Lead, Sr Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I’m a hands-on technology leader with 20+ years of experience delivering scalable, secure, and resilient software systems across finance, healthcare, tax, and clinical research domains.

I’ve been fortunate to contribute to impactful platforms — from orchestrating millions of daily NACHA transactions in the payroll space to developing complex, high-risk clinical trial systems with truly randomized subject allocation and protocol logic. I specialize in modernizing legacy systems into cloud-native, modular architectures, and bring deep expertise in event-driven systems using tools like NServiceBus and AWS SNS/SQS.

Earlier in my career, I led CMS modernization initiatives at McKinsey and PMI, helped scale enterprise software across distributed teams, and contributed to global clinical trial platforms supporting 500+ studies at Almac. I thrive in fast-paced, high-trust environments where I can drive architecture, mentor engineers, and make strategic technology decisions that align with long-term business goals.

Known for adaptability and ownership, I bring a builder’s mindset to every challenge — whether it’s designing distributed systems, introducing new frameworks, or shaping product direction in lean teams. I’m deeply passionate about learning emerging technologies and delivering solutions that are elegant, maintainable, and rooted in real-world value.
